channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal Rio de Janeiro (RJ) 2026: veja lista com nomes e números para votar
item.description: The list of candidates for federal deputy in Rio de Janeiro for 2026 is available with names and voting numbers. Voters will be able to choose representatives for the Chamber of Deputies starting in 2027. The data was updated on September 28, 2026.

item.title: “Ninguém vai avacalhar com Nossa Senhora Aparecida”, diz Lula
item.description: Lula stated during a rally in Belém that no one will disrespect Our Lady of Aparecida while he is president, criticizing pastor André Valadão. He also called for investigations into Daniel Vorcaro and denied any intent to remove the title of patron saint. Flávio Bolsonaro denied involvement in the alleged fake news about removing the devotion, attributing it to the PT.

item.title: Análise: Lula e Flávio dão sinais de que eleição não terminará nas urnas
item.description: The campaigns of Lula and Flávio show signs that the 2026 election may not be decided by the ballot box, with both sides preparing arguments to challenge the result. Lula may invoke alleged U.S. interference, while Flávio is also positioned to question the election's legitimacy.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta terça (29/9)
item.description: Six candidates compete for the São Paulo governorship in 2026, with Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad leading the polls. On Tuesday (September 29), candidates follow campaign schedules including TV debates, metro flyer distribution, and podcasts. The election race enters the final stretch with only six days remaining before the first round.

item.title: Fim das bets: futuro da MP divide Congresso, que aguarda passar as eleições
item.description: The MP banning sports betting ('bets') and online casinos divides Congress opinions, with proceedings suspended until after elections. Sanctioned by Lula, it takes immediate effect but requires parliamentary approval; critics warn of R$ 400 million losses for clubs like Flamengo.

item.title: Em SP, liderança do Agro "projeta" ministério para secretário de Tarcísio
item.description: At an event at the São Paulo Commercial Association, São Paulo Secretary of Agriculture Geraldo Melo Filho was humorously suggested as a potential Minister of Agriculture in a hypothetical Flávio Bolsonaro government, by SRB president Sérgio Bortolozzo. Melo Filho, a former Incra president under Bolsonaro, has been publicly active alongside Flávio and Tarcísio, reinforcing his alignment with the PL. His mention prompted light reactions and included criticism of federal agricultural policy.

item.title: Flávio busca estratégias para minimizar desgaste com episódio Nossa Senhora
item.description: Five days before the election, Flávio Bolsonaro changed his stance on the controversy involving a supposed proposal to remove the title of Patroness of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida, thanking the CNBB and avoiding further criticism. The campaign aims to minimize backlash among Catholic voters, who represent nearly 57% of the population, through strategies that reinforce religious alliances and reduce the controversy's impact before the first round.

item.title: Confira as agendas dos candidatos à Presidência nesta terça-feira (29/9)
item.description: Presidential candidates have scheduled campaign activities across various cities, including walking tours, interviews, supporter meetings and public events. Schedules may be adjusted throughout the day according to each campaign’s coordination. The outlet reached out to campaign teams to compile the agendas.

item.title: Quem pode ser preso durante o Defeso Eleitoral? Veja o que diz a PCDF
item.description: During the Electoral Restraining Period, candidates and voters are immune from arrest except in cases of flagrante delict. The Civil and Military Police continue operations normally, respecting legal limitations and immediately handing over detainees to the competent judge.

item.title: Lula e Flávio ainda não fizeram campanha em 5 estados; veja mapa
item.description: Five days before the first round of elections, neither Lula nor Flávio have visited five states: Acre, Espírito Santo, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rondônia, and Tocantins. Flávio has visited 18 states, while Lula has reached 14 states and the Federal District, combining institutional and electoral agendas.

item.title: Crise no STF se arrasta por quase um mês e chega ao TSE às vésperas do 1º turno
item.description: The STF crisis, intensified by the clash between Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, reaches the TSE on the eve of the first round, risking electoral impact. Mendonça's faction seeks to expedite rulings on TSE post-removal orders, while internal division, marked by a 'war of decisions', weakens the judiciary.

item.title: Lula diz que mulheres aprendem a “tomar toque” desde pequenas
item.description: President Lula criticized men for not undergoing prostate exams, emphasizing the importance of prevention and robotic surgery in treating prostate cancer, which he compared to women's ability to 'take touch' from an early age. During a rally in Belém, he highlighted health advancements in Pará, including the first robotic prostate surgery in Brazil's North region.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao GDF a menos de uma semana das eleições
item.description: On Tuesday (September 29), GDF candidates carry out an intense campaign schedule across several administrative regions of the Federal District. Celina Leão (PP), Leandro Grass (PT), Paula Belmonte (PSDB), Ricardo Cappelli (PSB), Samara Mineiro (UP), Robson (PSTU), Kiko Caputo (Novo), Elisson Ferreira (Agir) and others participate in leafleting, TV debates and voter meetings. Notably, José Roberto Arruda (PSD) had his candidacy blocked by the TSE.

item.title: Flávio tem 45,2% contra 44,7% de Lula no 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll shows Lula and Flávio technically tied in the second round, with 44.7% and 45.2% of voting intentions respectively. The survey also simulates other scenarios, with Lula leading against Zema, Caiado, and Cury. In the first round, Lula leads with 41.1%, followed by Flávio with 37.8%.

item.title: Mensagens indicam proximidade entre Vorcaro e Motta: 'Queria estar mesmo era em Mônaco com você'
item.description: Leaked messages reveal intimate conversations between Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, and Hugo Motta, President of the Chamber of Deputies, suggesting a close relationship. The exchanges include compliments, invitations to exclusive events, and references to travel, fueling speculation about potential favors or undue influence between political and business figures. The case may impact discussions on ethics and transparency in the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da decisão de Fux que barrou posts sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux suspended a decision by Flávio Dino and ordered the removal of posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the alleged plan to remove Our Lady from the title of Patroness of Brazil, arguing that the Supreme Court cannot determine the dissemination of proven false news.

item.title: Lula declara apoio a Delúbio Soares, condenado no mensalão e na Lava Jato
item.description: President Lula expressed support for the candidacy of Delúbio Soares, a former PT treasurer convicted in the Mensalão and Lava Jato scandals, framing him as a victim of political persecution and calling for special votes. Soares is running for a seat in the Chamber of Deputies byPT-GO after years of corruption convictions.

item.title: Fux derruba decisão de Dino e suspende posts envolvendo Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux suspended a decision by Minister Flávio Dino that had ordered the removal of posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida. The dispute arose after comedian Antônio Tabet associated the PL candidate with the alleged intention to strip the Patroness of Brazil of her title. Fux decided to bring the case to the Supreme Court plenary and ordered digital platforms to refrain from further enforcement of Dino's decision.

item.title: Fux suspende decisão de Dino, e redes devem excluir posts sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Luiz Fux suspended Flávio Dino's decision and ordered the removal of social media posts about rumors involving Our Lady of Aparecida and Flávio Bolsonaro. The suspension responds to a request from Dino's defense, following controversial posts by comedian Antonio Tabet.

item.title: Quaest, 1º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, cor e religião
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 28 shows Lula leading with 39% of voting intentions in the first round, against 34% for Flávio Bolsonaro. The five-point difference exceeds the margin of error, ending the technical tie from the previous poll. The survey interviewed 2,004 people between September 24 and 27 with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Quaest: Lula x Flávio tem vaivém entre mulheres, empate técnico no Sudeste e vantagens mantidas em setembro
item.description: Quaest poll from September 28 shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio in Southeast, each with 42%. Lula leads among women, low-income voters, and Catholics, while Flávio leads among youth and higher-educated voters.

item.title: TV Globo promove debate com candidatos ao governo de SP nesta terça; veja regras, quem participa e como assistir
item.description: TV Globo hosts a debate between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad, with rules based on parliamentary representation. The event will be broadcast live after the telenovela 'Quem Ama Cuida' across multiple platforms.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Roupa, celular, números dos candidatos – o que pode e o que não pode no dia da eleição
item.description: The 2026 elections in Brazil follow strict rules to ensure voting secrecy and order, prohibiting cell phones, collective clothing, and campaign materials inside the electronic booth. Voters may express themselves individually with t-shirts or stickers, and casual attire like shorts and flip-flops are allowed, except intimate wear. Voting hours are unified nationwide from 8 AM to 5 PM, and carrying weapons is banned within 100 meters of polling stations, except for authorized security forces.

item.title: VÍDEO: como os partidos recebem recursos?
item.description: The video explains how Brazilian parties receive public funding through the electoral fund (R$5 billion in 2026) and the partisan fund, distributed based on election performance. Allocation considers 2% equally, 35% by Chamber vote share, 48% by number of elected deputies, and 15% by Senate representation. Parties like PL, PT, União Brasil, PSD, PP, and MDB lead the distribution.

item.title: Óculos inteligentes são proibidos na cabine de votação, mas não são citados nas regras do TSE
item.description: Although smart glasses are not explicitly mentioned in TSE rules, they fall under the prohibition of bringing devices that may compromise voting secrecy inside polling booths. Concern is growing with the rise of connected devices equipped with cameras that could record or share votes. The TSE reinforces the ban based on Article 137 of the General Electoral Process Acts, but enforcement relies on identification by polling supervisors.

item.title: Fux suspende decisão de Dino e retoma determinação de Mendonça sobre posts de Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux suspended Justice Flávio Dino's decision that had allowed posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the removal of Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint. This move reinstated André Mendonça's orders from the TSE to remove the posts, including one by comedian Antonio Tabet. Fux acted on Bolsonaro's defense team's request, citing concerns over freedom of expression and electoral justice implications.

item.title: Lula pede que aliados revejam candidatura tripla ao Senado no Pará
item.description: President Lula called for allies to reconsider the triple candidacy for the Senate in Pará, emphasizing the need to unite forces to prevent the election of a candidate aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro. He suggested party leaders evaluate who has the best conditions to be elected among Helder Barbalho, Chicão, and Celso Sabino.

item.title: Denúncias de propaganda política irregular já somam mais de 50 mil no TSE
item.description: The Electoral Justice has received 51,395 complaints of irregular advertising through the Pardal application since the start of the campaign for the 2026 general elections. The system, created by the Supreme Federal Court, enables monitoring of political content on social media.

item.title: Meu vice, Alfredo Gaspar, é católico fervoroso. Meu pai também é católico, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro highlighted the Catholic faith of his running mate, Alfredo Gaspar, and his father, Jair Bolsonaro, as an ideological alignment point in the PL presidential campaign. The reference was made during an interview where he emphasized traditional values tied to Catholic faith. Religious themes carry weight among the evangelical and Catholic base of the candidate.

item.title: Flávio: Caneta de emagrecimento no SUS é a nova picanha do Lula, ele não vai entregar
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) criticized President Lula's proposal to distribute weight-loss pens through the SUS, calling it the 'new picanha' and claiming Lula will not deliver on the promise. The statement was made during his electoral campaign, reinforcing the PL's stance on controversial public health policies.

item.title: Flávio: Não existe projeto de lei sobre retirada do título de N. Sra de Padroeira do Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, denied again having a bill to remove the title of Our Lady of Aparecida as Patroness of Brazil, accusing others of spreading the claim. He reiterated his stance to protect the religious symbol during the election campaign.

item.title: Flávio: Olham para mim enxergando legado de Jair Bolsonaro com outra postura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, states he aims to represent Jair Bolsonaro's political legacy but with a distinct posture. He emphasized continuing the ideological line of his father, former president, while advocating an updated approach.

item.title: PSD declara apoio a Celina Leão após Arruda ter candidatura rejeitada pelo TSE
item.description: The PSD declared support for Celina Leão (PP) and her running mate Gustavo Rocha (Republicanos) for the Federal District government after José Arruda had his candidacy rejected by the TSE. The decision was announced in a meeting between party representatives and the current governor. The PSD's support strengthens the alliance between the parties in the district election.

item.title: Janja volta a surfar em fake news sobre padroeira do Brasil
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula delivered a polarizing speech at a campaign rally in Belém, countering false claims that Flávio Bolsonaro sought to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her status as Brazil’s patron saint, while accusing him of ties to a militia-linked 'clique.' She emphasized President Lula’s record and stressed outreach to undecided voters to secure a first-round win.

item.title: O que mostra a movimentação de Lula e Flávio nas últimas duas pesquisas presidenciais
item.description: Polling data shows favorable movement for Lula in the first round, keeping the race tight against Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential second round. Indecisive voters may become increasingly important in a highly competitive election with small swings.

item.title: Governo cria comitê contra bets ilegais; saiba como funcionará
item.description: The federal government created the Interinstitucional Committee for Monitoring the Exploitation and Illegal Advertising of Fixed-Odds Bets, composed of 15 federal agency representatives, to combat illegal gambling activities following the enactment of Provisional Measure 1.394/2026. The committee will share intelligence, establish an integrated database of irregular domains, set blocking protocols, and submit biannual reports to the Casa Civil. Meetings will occur every six months with potential extraordinary sessions.

item.title: Governo Lula adia reunião com times de futebol para discutir MP das Bets
item.description: The federal government postponed the meeting with football clubs and the CBF regarding the impact of the sports betting ban, citing only logistical reasons. The new date will be set and announced later. Ministers such as Dario Durigan emphasized the intention to listen to the sector's demands before making decisions.

item.title: TSE recebeu mais de 50 mil denúncias de propaganda irregular
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has received 51,395 complaints about irregular campaign advertising through the Pardal app since the start of the 2026 election cycle. The most common type (43.78%) involves irregular advertisements on public roads, followed by ads on private property and public assets. São Paulo leads with 10,388 complaints, and 27% of cases have been converted into formal proceedings.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio nos cinco maiores colégios eleitorais do país
item.description: Recent Quaest polls show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in the first round in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, while Lula leads in Minas Gerais. Technical ties are indicated in São Paulo and Minas Gerais due to margin of error, suggesting close competition. In the second round, Flávio maintains an advantage in São Paulo, with a technical tie observed in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Fachin avalia proposta para pautar caso da Nossa Senhora na 4ª feira
item.description: STF President Luiz Edson Fachin is considering whether to bring to the plenary his decision overturning a preliminary injunction by André Mendonça that allowed publication about Our Lady of Aparecida. The case has drawn criticism from TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques, who questions Supreme Court interference in electoral justice.

item.title: TRE-SP proíbe propaganda de Tarcísio com participação de Nunes
item.description: TRE-SP banned a 30-second campaign ad featuring Tarcísio de Freitas and São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes, ruling Nunes acted as a supporter, exceeding the legal 25% participation limit. The decision was upheld by majority, with Tarcísio’s defense announcing an appeal. The ad highlighted partnerships between the city and state governments.

item.title: Lula diz que 'ninguém vai avacalhar com Nossa Senhora Aparecida' enquanto ele for presidente
item.description: Lula vowed to protect Nossa Senhora Aparecida and criticized the Lagoinha church over ties to Vorcaro. Flávio Bolsonaro denied involvement in removing the Patron Saint title, calling the controversy fake news and blaming the PT.

item.title: Janja chama Flávio de “Bozo filho” e associa clã Bolsonaro a milícia
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva referred to Flávio Bolsonaro as 'Bozo son' and linked his family to the 'familia' group during a rally in Belém. She also referenced investigations into alleged ties between Flávio and militias, along with the Banco Master case, reinforcing criticism of the previous administration.

item.title: Vorcaro pede para votar nas eleições e título é transferido para a Papuda
item.description: Former banker Daniel Vorcaro, currently held in preventive detention at the Papuda prison complex, has had his voter registration transferred to the facility and remains eligible to vote in the 2026 elections because his conviction has not yet become final. He is under investigation in the Compliance Zero operation for alleged billion-dollar frauds in the Brazilian financial system.

item.title: Flávio: PT aposta na divisão, agora tiveram audácia de colocar católicos contra evangélicos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused the PT of promoting polarization and attempting to divide Catholics and Evangelicals, denying rumors about removing Our Lady of Aparecida's title as Brazil's patron saint. In an interview with the SantoFlow Podcast, he emphasized the need to avoid a more divided country and reaffirmed continuity with his father Jair Bolsonaro's legacy, but with a different stance.

item.title: Lula diz que Nossa Senhora 'não será avacalhada' e ataca templo de Vorcaro: 'Igreja mentirosa é aquela da Lagoinha'
item.description: Lula used a rally in Belém to defend Our Lady of Aparecida and criticize pastor André Valadão and Daniel Vorcaro. He indirectly attacked Jair Bolsonaro and reaffirmed his stance on sovereignty and Trump.

item.title: AO VIVO: LULA EM BELÉM DO PARÁ (ELEIÇÕES 2026- NOTÍCIAS POLÍTICA)
item.description: Lula visits Belém do Pará during the 2026 election campaign. The event is broadcast live but the video shows technical failures and audio limitations. The coverage reinforces the PT leader's role in the national scenario.

item.title: O bastidor da queda de braço entre TSE e STF no caso da Nossa Senhora
item.description: Tensions are rising between the TSE and STF over jurisdiction and oversight of electoral decisions, particularly following the appointment of Nunes Marques and André Mendonça by Jair Bolsonaro. The conflict intensified with the Flávio Bolsonaro controversy over references to Nossa Senhora Aparecida, brought before the STF plenary by Flávio Dino.

item.title: Fim das bets: sindicato dos clubes de futebol e das federações pede ao STF suspensão da MP ou período de transição de seis meses
item.description: The National Union of Professional Football Associations (Sinafut) requested the STF to suspend the MP banning betting sites or, alternatively, a six-month transition period, citing impacts on the 2027 budgets and national competitions. The entity, representing clubs, federations and the CBF, joins betting houses in challenging the provisional measure.

item.title: Ancelotti usa Raphinha em nova posição e quer repetir sucesso do Barcelona
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti chooses to use Raphinha as a striker for the Brazilian national team, leveraging the strong start to his season at Barcelona. The player, who has already scored 14 goals and provided 4 assists in nine matches, will be promoted to lead the attack in a 4-3-3 formation. Ancelotti highlighted Raphinha's positive adaptation to the new role.
